description:
Detect hour-of-day seasonality in alert volume.

        Real detection from the organization's actual alert history (24
        hourly buckets summed across the requested window). Day-of-week/
        week-of-month cycles are not computed, so pattern_type is always
        "hourly" (or "insufficient_data" below a 24-data-point floor),
        never a fabricated "daily"/"weekly" label.
name: whitebox_alert_intelligence_detect_seasonality

description:
Combine real alert-volume time-series data with a real
        hour-of-day seasonality estimate, a numpy.polyfit trend prediction
        (with an R²-based confidence score), and real z-score anomaly
        detection over the same window -- all computed from the
        organization's actual alert history. Not a full forecasting model
        (no ARIMA/Prophet).
name: whitebox_alert_intelligence_enhanced_trend_analysis

description:
Forecast future alert volume with confidence intervals.

        Uses a least-squares linear trend (numpy.polyfit) over real
        historical hourly alert counts, shaped by the organization's real
        hour-of-day seasonality. NOT ARIMA/Prophet. Forward-looking
        anomaly_predictions are intentionally always empty -- predicting
        future anomalies needs its own model, out of scope here; anomaly
        detection over *observed* data is available via
        whitebox_alert_intelligence_enhanced_trend_analysis instead. Falls
        back to an honestly-labeled zeroed forecast
        (seasonal_pattern.type == "insufficient_data") when fewer than 24
        hourly data points exist.
name: whitebox_alert_intelligence_forecast_volume

description:
Generate a SHAP/LIME explanation and block until it's computed.

        For a fast model this is fine; for slow models prefer
        whitebox_explanations_generate_async + polling instead, since this
        call has no timeout of its own.

        Args:
            model_id: Registered model's ID
            instance: Feature values for the instance to explain, e.g. {"age": 42, "income": 50000}
            method: "shap" or "lime" (uses the model's configured default if omitted)
            prediction_id: Optional ID of the prediction this explanation is for
            num_features: Number of top features to return (1-100)
            num_samples: Number of samples the explainer draws (100-50000); higher is slower but more stable
            use_cache: Reuse a cached explanation for an identical instance if one exists
name: whitebox_explanations_generate

description:
Start real SHAP/LIME explanation generation for a model instance.

        Returns immediately with a PENDING explanation_id -- this does NOT
        block until the explanation is ready. Computation happens on a
        Celery worker and can take several seconds to tens of seconds.
        Call whitebox_explanations_get with the returned explanation_id and
        poll (e.g. every 1-2 seconds) until status is no longer "pending"
        before reading feature_weights.

        Args:
            model_id: Registered model's ID
            instance: Feature values for the instance to explain, e.g. {"age": 42, "income": 50000}
            method: "shap" or "lime" (uses the model's configured default if omitted)
            prediction_id: Optional ID of the prediction this explanation is for
            num_features: Number of top features to return (1-100)
            num_samples: Number of samples the explainer draws (100-50000); higher is slower but more stable
name: whitebox_explanations_generate_async

description:
Start explanation generation for multiple instances at once (non-blocking).

        Dispatches one Celery task per instance (max 100 instances per call)
        and returns immediately with one PENDING explanation_id per instance.
        Poll whitebox_explanations_get for each ID, same as
        whitebox_explanations_generate_async.

        Args:
            model_id: Registered model's ID
            instances: Feature values for each instance to explain (max 100)
            method: "shap" or "lime" (uses the model's configured default if omitted)
            num_features: Number of top features to return per explanation (1-100)
            num_samples: Number of samples the explainer draws (100-50000)
            parallel: Retained for backward compatibility; not read by the backend
name: whitebox_explanations_generate_bulk

description:
Get an explanation by ID, including its status and (once ready) results.

        Poll this after whitebox_explanations_generate_async: while status
        is "pending" the explanation is still computing on a background
        worker and feature_weights will be empty. Poll again until status
        is "completed" (read feature_weights, base_value, score) or
        "failed" (read the error).
name: whitebox_explanations_get

description:
Run a bias/fairness audit on model predictions across demographic groups.

        Unlike most WhiteBoxXAI tools, this is not a data-source query: the
        caller must already have the ground-truth labels, predicted labels,
        and per-attribute group assignments in hand (e.g. pulled via
        whitebox_predictions_query and joined with demographic data), all
        aligned to the same sample order.

        Args:
            model_id: Registered model's ID
            sensitive_attributes: Protected attributes to analyze (race,
                gender, age, ethnicity, religion, disability,
                sexual_orientation, national_origin, marital_status, or custom)
            y_true: Ground-truth labels, same length/order as y_pred and group_data values
            y_pred: Predicted labels
            group_data: Per-attribute group assignments, e.g.
                {"gender": ["M", "F", "M", ...]}, one array per attribute in
                sensitive_attributes, same length/order as y_true/y_pred
            y_prob: Optional predicted probabilities (enables calibration metrics)
            metrics_to_compute: Optional subset of fairness metrics to compute
                (demographic_parity, equal_opportunity, equalized_odds,
                disparate_impact, predictive_parity, calibration,
                false_positive_rate_parity, false_negative_rate_parity,
                statistical_parity_difference, average_odds_difference) --
                computes all of them if omitted

        Returns:
            Full audit results: per-metric pass/fail against fairness
            thresholds, per-group comparisons, an overall fairness score,
            and mitigation recommendations.
name: whitebox_fairness_audit

description: Get full bias audit results by audit_id.
name: whitebox_fairness_get_audit

Get history for one specific fairness metric on a model.

                false_negative_rate_parity, statistical_parity_difference,
                average_odds_difference
            days: Lookback window in days (1-365)

description:
List registered models, optionally filtered by status/type/tags/search text.

        Args:
            skip: Number of results to skip (pagination)
            limit: Maximum results to return (1-1000)
            status_filter: One of ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DEPRECATED, ARCHIVED
            model_type: e.g. "classification", "regression"
            search: Free-text search over name/description
            tags: Comma-separated list of tags to filter by
name: whitebox_models_list

description: List Git-backed version sources for a model, newest first.
name: whitebox_models_list_git_versions

description:
Register a new model in WhiteBoxXAI's model registry.

        Args:
            name: Model name (alphanumeric, spaces, dashes, underscores only)
            model_type: e.g. "classification", "regression"
            features: List of input feature names
            baseline_metrics: Baseline performance metrics, e.g. {"accuracy": 0.94}
            framework: ML framework (sklearn, pytorch, tensorflow, etc.)
            version: Model version (semantic versioning, e.g. "1.0.0")
            description: Human-readable description
            target_variable: Name of the target/label variable
            fairness_attributes: Sensitive attributes to track for bias auditing
            tags: Free-form tags for search/filtering

        Returns:
            The registered model's record, including its generated model_id.
name: whitebox_models_register

description: Restore a previously archived model to active status.
name: whitebox_models_restore

description: Partially update a model's metadata. Only provided fields are changed.
name: whitebox_models_update

description:
Refresh a model's baseline metrics/profile, e.g. after retraining.

        This baseline is what drift detection compares recent predictions
        against, so update it whenever the model is retrained or revalidated.
name: whitebox_models_update_baseline

description: Update a model's status: ACTIVE, INACTIVE, DEPRECATED, or ARCHIVED.
name: whitebox_models_update_status

description: Generate a markdown changelog between two Git-backed model versions.
name: whitebox_models_version_changelog

description: List all versions of a model by name, newest first.
name: whitebox_models_versions

description: Get a single logged prediction by its prediction_id.
name: whitebox_predictions_get

description:
Log a single model prediction for monitoring.

        Args:
            model_id: Registered model's ID
            input_data: Input features as a JSON object
            output_data: The model's prediction/output as a JSON object
            prediction_id: Optional external prediction ID (generated if omitted)
            latency_ms: Prediction latency in milliseconds
            metadata: Additional free-form metadata
name: whitebox_predictions_log

description:
Log up to 1000 predictions in a single batch call.

        Args:
            model_id: Registered model's ID
            predictions: List of objects, each with "input_data" and
                "output_data" keys (and optionally "prediction_id",
                "latency_ms", "metadata")

        Returns:
            Summary: {total, logged, failed, errors}
name: whitebox_predictions_log_batch

description:
Query logged predictions for a model, optionally within a time range.

        Args:
            model_id: Registered model's ID (required)
            start_time: ISO-8601 timestamp; only predictions after this time
            end_time: ISO-8601 timestamp; only predictions before this time
            limit: Maximum results to return (1-1000)
            offset: Number of results to skip
name: whitebox_predictions_query

description: Get the most recent predictions for a model (max 100).
name: whitebox_predictions_recent

description:
Get prediction volume/latency statistics for a model.

        Defaults to the trailing 24 hours if no time range is given.
name: whitebox_predictions_stats

description:
Advance a prompt version through the lifecycle stages (design -> verify -> deploy -> retired).

        Promotion from verify to deploy requires a verified benchmark run.
name: whitebox_prompts_advance_stage

description: Compute prompt drift analysis comparing production completions with baseline expectations.
name: whitebox_prompts_compute_drift

description: Create a new prompt template container for versioning.
name: whitebox_prompts_create_template

description: Create a new governed prompt version in 'design' lifecycle stage.
name: whitebox_prompts_create_version

description:
Promote a prompt version to active production deployment.

        Enforces single active deployment per template and requires benchmark verification (unless force=True).
name: whitebox_prompts_deploy

description: Get a specific prompt drift report with metrics, divergence, and auditor verdict.
name: whitebox_prompts_get_drift_report

description: Get security incidents and alerts associated with a prompt version.
name: whitebox_prompts_get_incidents

description: Get details of a specific prompt template by ID.
name: whitebox_prompts_get_template

description: Get details, lifecycle stage, and verification status of a prompt version.
name: whitebox_prompts_get_version

description: List historical prompt drift reports for a prompt version.
name: whitebox_prompts_list_drift_reports

description: List all prompt governance templates for the authenticated tenant.
name: whitebox_prompts_list_templates

description: List all append-only governed versions for a prompt template.
name: whitebox_prompts_list_versions

description: Emergency rollback to a target version or the most recently verified version.
name: whitebox_prompts_rollback

description:
Create a RAG evaluation, aggregating already-logged retrievals for
        each query. Queries with no matching logged retrieval are reported
        in detailed_results.queries_without_data, not silently scored as zero.
name: whitebox_rag_create_evaluation

description: Get a specific RAG evaluation by ID.
name: whitebox_rag_get_evaluation

description: Get a specific retrieval log by ID.
name: whitebox_rag_get_retrieval

description: List RAG evaluations with optional filters.
name: whitebox_rag_list_evaluations

description:
Query retrieval logs for a model. model_id is required (owned by
        the caller's organization) until organization-wide RAG log scoping ships.
name: whitebox_rag_list_retrievals

description:
Log a retrieval operation, with real quality metrics computed
        server-side when ground_truth_ids is supplied.
name: whitebox_rag_log_retrieval

description:
Get Precision@K metrics for the given K values (default [1, 3, 5, 10]).
        A K with no scoreable logged retrievals returns null, not a
        fabricated 0.0.
name: whitebox_rag_metrics_precision

description: Get average relevance metrics (context/answer/faithfulness).
name: whitebox_rag_metrics_relevance

description: Get aggregated RAG statistics (precision/recall/MRR/NDCG/relevance/latency).
name: whitebox_rag_stats

description: Get RAG quality metrics trend over time (granularity: hour/day/week).
name: whitebox_rag_trends

description: Get a single AI risk register entry by ID.
name: whitebox_risk_register_get

description:
List AI risk register entries, optionally filtered.

        Args:
            status: One of identified, assessed, mitigation_planned, mitigated, closed
            severity: One of low, medium, high, critical
            category: Risk category (org-specific taxonomy, e.g. bias, drift, security)
            model_id: Restrict to risks linked to one registered model
            limit: Page size
            skip: Page offset

        Returns:
            {"items": [...], "total": int, "skip": int, "limit": int} --
            each item includes `iso42001_clause_refs`, the ISO 42001 clause
            IDs (e.g. "ISO42001-8.3") this risk maps to.
name: whitebox_risk_register_list

description:
Get the likelihood x impact heat map and top open risks across
        the organization's risk register.
name: whitebox_risk_register_portfolio

description:
Analyze content for toxicity, PII, and harmful content.

        Returns full safety analysis: toxicity_scores, pii_results,
        harmful_content, safety_status, flagged_categories, etc.
name: whitebox_safety_analyze

description:
Analyze multiple content items in one request (max 100). Items
        that fail analysis are silently skipped, not raised.
name: whitebox_safety_analyze_batch

description:
Create a safety threshold configuration controlling when content
        is flagged as unsafe. action_on_violation: "warning", "block", or "alert".
name: whitebox_safety_create_threshold

description: Delete a safety threshold configuration.
name: whitebox_safety_delete_threshold

description: Get a specific safety score by ID.
name: whitebox_safety_get_score

description: Query safety analysis scores with filters.
name: whitebox_safety_get_scores

description: Get a specific safety threshold by ID.
name: whitebox_safety_get_threshold

description: List safety thresholds for the caller's organization.
name: whitebox_safety_list_thresholds

description:
Get aggregated safety statistics (per-category toxicity averages,
        flagged categories, PII types).
name: whitebox_safety_stats

description: Get content-safety trend over time (granularity: hour/day/week).
name: whitebox_safety_trends

description:
Update a safety threshold configuration. Only non-null arguments
        are changed.
name: whitebox_safety_update_threshold
